module.name: aws_eks_cluster_hp_nodes
module.description: Add a dedicated high-performance EKS managed node group for hosting TMM data-plane pods. Implements the generic 3-interface TMM model: CNI (ens5, VPC CNI) + external (ens7, on TMM-external subnet) + internal (ens8, on TMM-internal subnet). Creates per-AZ subnet pairs (tagged f5-bnk-role=tmm-external / tmm-internal), an IAM node role with ENI-management permissions, a launch template that bootstraps both secondary ENIs at first boot with node.k8s.amazonaws.com/no_manage=true, and the node group with app=f5-tmm label. Used by aws-eks-existing-cluster-with-hp-nodes + aws-eks-cluster-create-with-hp-nodes blueprints.

required.reason: Provides eks_cluster_name + vpc_id + vpc_cidr + node_subnet_ids + availability_zones for an existing cluster.

optional.reason: Alternative upstream — emits the same output shape so HP-nodes works identically for greenfield deploys.

required.name: aws_access_key_id
required.description: AWS access key ID. Resolved by Forge's credential template at deploy time (any auth method).

required.name: eks_cluster_name
required.description: Name of the EKS cluster the HP node group attaches to.

required.name: vpc_cidr
required.description: Cluster VPC primary CIDR, used for auto-carving TMM-external + TMM-internal subnets when explicit lists are empty.

required.name: availability_zones
required.description: AZs to spread HP nodes across.

required.name: node_subnet_ids
required.description: Cluster subnet IDs where the HP managed node group places its PRIMARY ENI. Both secondary ENIs land in dedicated TMM subnets via user-data.

optional.name: aws_session_token
optional.description: AWS session token. Populated for STS / SSO / assumed-role; empty for static keys.

optional.name: tmm_external_subnet_cidrs
optional.description: Explicit TMM-external subnet CIDRs. Empty list = auto-carve from vpc_cidr.

optional.name: tmm_internal_subnet_cidrs
optional.description: Explicit TMM-internal subnet CIDRs. Empty list = auto-carve from vpc_cidr.

optional.name: instance_type
optional.description: EC2 instance type. Must support at least 3 total ENIs (primary + 2 secondary). m5n.large (default) supports 3; m5n.xlarge/c5n.xlarge support 4+.

optional.name: node_count_per_az
optional.description: Desired HP nodes per AZ. 0 = skip the node group entirely (subnets still created when tag_subnets_for_tmm = true).

optional.name: node_disk_size_gb
optional.description: Root volume size for HP nodes.

optional.name: external_eni_device_index
optional.description: Device index for the TMM-external secondary ENI. 2 → ens7 on AL2023 (matches ens7-ipvlan-l2 NAD default).

optional.name: internal_eni_device_index
optional.description: Device index for the TMM-internal secondary ENI. 3 → ens8 on AL2023 (matches ens8-ipvlan-l2 NAD default).

optional.name: additional_ips_per_eni
optional.description: Additional private IPs allocated on EACH secondary ENI at creation. 0 = let cneinstall's IPAM manage allocation.

optional.name: node_label_app
optional.description: Value for the 'app' label on HP nodes; FLO matches this to schedule TMM pods.

optional.name: tag_subnets_for_tmm
optional.description: Tag TMM-external subnets with 'f5-bnk-role=tmm-external' and TMM-internal subnets with 'f5-bnk-role=tmm-internal' for cneinstall auto-discovery.

key_outputs.name: tmm_external_subnets_by_az
key_outputs.description: AZ → TMM-external subnets, in cluster-register output shape.

key_outputs.name: tmm_internal_subnets_by_az
key_outputs.description: AZ → TMM-internal subnets, in cluster-register output shape.

key_outputs.name: hp_node_group_arn
key_outputs.description: ARN of the HP managed node group. Empty when node_count_per_az = 0.

key_outputs.name: hp_node_group_name
key_outputs.description: Name of the HP managed node group.

key_outputs.name: hp_node_role_arn
key_outputs.description: IAM role ARN attached to HP nodes.

optional.name: aws_session_token
optional.description: AWS credential template (STS / SSO / assumed-role only).
